title: Complex Layers of Sparse Formal Neurons for High-Dimensional Classification
description: Source code, datasets, manuscript source, figures, and reproducibility artifacts for the PeerJ Computer Science submission "Complex Layers of Sparse Formal Neurons for High-Dimensional Classification".

creators.name: Bobrowski, Leon
creators.affiliation: Institute of Biocybernetics and Biomedical Engineering, Polish Academy of Sciences

notes: The MIT license applies to the repository source code. The file data/colon_cancer.csv is redistributed as a processed form of the Bioconductor colonCA experiment data package and follows the upstream colonCA LGPL package license, not the repository MIT code license. The generated paper-run result bundles are packaged as a separate Zenodo artifact named complex-layers-paper-runs-v1.0.0.zip.
